datasync.title: Your database
datasync.lead: Keep a copy of your clinic's data in your own MySQL or PostgreSQL database, for your reports and your own tools.
datasync.log_empty_text: Press “Copy now” or wait for the schedule.
datasync.form_sub: Details are stored encrypted. The password is never shown again.
datasync.host_help: A public server name or IP address.
datasync.password_help: Use a user that may only create and change tables in this database.
datasync.password_saved: A password is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
datasync.prefix_help: Tables are named like db_patients. Other tables in your database are never touched.
datasync.ssl_help: Recommended. Turn off only if your server does not support it.
datasync.ds_clinic_text: Doctor profiles, fees and working hours (without salaries), and the service list.
datasync.ds_patients_text: Name, phone, email, date of birth, gender and insurance — no medical details.
datasync.ds_appointments_text: Dates, times, doctor, service, status, arrival and payment status (booking notes are not copied).
datasync.ds_billing_text: Invoices, their lines, discounts, payment methods and cash-drawer closings.
datasync.ds_supplies_text: Suppliers, supply items, stock levels and movements.
datasync.ds_payroll_text: Salary payments, bonuses and deductions, base salaries and commission rules.
datasync.ds_clinical_text: Consultation notes and diagnoses, vital signs, prescriptions, allergies and chronic conditions.
datasync.sensitive_title: Medical records and salaries are off unless you choose them
datasync.sensitive_text: Once copied, this data lives on your server and your clinic is responsible for protecting it: who can open the database, backups, and patient confidentiality under the law that applies to you. Only choose what you really need.
datasync.accept: I understand that my clinic is responsible for protecting the copied medical and salary data.
datasync.remove_confirm: Stop copying and delete the saved connection? The tables already in your database stay there.
datasync.how1: Create an empty database and a user on your server (MySQL 5.7+, MariaDB 10.3+ or PostgreSQL 11+). The user needs permission to create, change and fill tables in that database only.
datasync.how2: Allow connections from DocBook's server in your database firewall (Remote MySQL, security group or pg_hba.conf).
datasync.how3: Enter the details here and press “Save and test”. DocBook checks the connection and that it can create tables.
datasync.how4: Choose the schedule. Each copy replaces the prefixed tables with fresh data; the table db_sync_info shows when the last copy finished.
datasync.note_oneway: The copy is one way: changes made in your database are not read back into DocBook.
datasync.note_times: Dates and times are stored in UTC; amounts are in the clinic currency.
datasync.note_kept: If you stop copying something, or disconnect, the tables already copied stay in your database until you delete them.
datasync.note_security: Internal and private network addresses are refused. Every change here and every copy is recorded in the audit log.
datasync.saved_ok: Saved. The connection works — the first copy will run shortly (or press “Copy now”).
datasync.saved_fail: Saved, but the connection test failed:
datasync.test_ok: The connection works and DocBook can create tables.
datasync.removed: Disconnected. Nothing will be copied any more.
datasync.ds_attendance_text: Clock-in and clock-out times of the staff (db_staff_attendance), without IP addresses.

errors_datasync.PRIVATE: This address is not reachable from DocBook. Use a public server name or IP address.
errors_datasync.DNS: The server name could not be found.
errors_datasync.REFUSED: The server refused the connection. Check the server, the port and that remote connections are allowed.
errors_datasync.TIMEOUT: The server did not answer in time. Allow DocBook's server in your database firewall.
errors_datasync.AUTH: The username or password was refused.
errors_datasync.NO_DB: This database does not exist on the server.
errors_datasync.NO_CREATE: This user may not create or change tables in this database.
errors_datasync.SSL: The secure connection failed. Check the server certificate, or turn off “Require a secure connection” only if the server does not support it.
errors_datasync.PASSWORD: The saved password can no longer be read. Enter it again.
errors_datasync.NO_KEY: This server has no encryption key set up, so the password cannot be stored safely. Ask the DocBook administrator to set APP_KEY.
errors_datasync.BUSY: A copy is already running. Try again in a few minutes.
errors_datasync.RUN_TIMEOUT: The copy took too long and was stopped. Try again later.
